content: Hello, one glance on your screen shot: it's a real mess you created by relocating message storage to another drive, and it would be very tricky to retrieve a working profile without many screen shots or having a look on your screen. If you have a backup copy of your complete "Thunderbird" folder containing your profile(s) I advise the following moves: The Thunderbird app closed, go to C:\Users\%username%\AppData\Roaming\Thunderbird\ and move the Thunderbird folder to your Desktop (or some other place). Then copy & paste the backup of your folder Thunderbird in C:\Users\%username%\AppData\Roaming\ here. On restart Thunderbird should display all your old POP accounts, folders and messages. It may happen that you will miss some recent messages already downloaded in the actual message storage local directory. But if necessary these messages could be recovered from the storage on F: drive.

  8. now , paste your copied thunderbird folder there.
  9. start thunderbird and all should be there
